personal_info.name: Wail Benoulha
personal_info.title: Full-Stack Developer | DevOps Engineer
personal_info.summary: I am a full-stack developer with strong experience in backend systems, SaaS platforms, DevOps engineering, and machine learning. I have built multiple real-world products including e-commerce SaaS platforms, educational AI systems, university admission platforms, and startup applications. My focus is on building scalable, efficient, and user-centered software solutions while continuously improving my skills in cloud computing, distributed systems, and artificial intelligence.

education.degree: Master in Data Science and Intelligent Systems

projects.name: Qarini
projects.description: Qarini is an AI-powered educational platform designed to modernize the learning and evaluation process in private schools. It enables teachers to automatically generate quizzes and assessments using AI, instantly correct student answers, and track academic progress through advanced analytics dashboards.

projects.name: Italyst
projects.description: Italyst is a centralized platform built to simplify the process of applying to Italian universities for international students. It aggregates structured and verified data about universities, including admission requirements, tuition fees, available programs, deadlines, and scholarship opportunities.

projects.name: ArtisanConnect
projects.description: ArtisanConnect is a digital platform that connects clients with professional artisans in construction and home improvement industries. It allows users to manage complete service workflows including painting, electrical work, flooring, and renovation projects.

projects.name: Bazario
projects.description: Bazario is a multi-tenant SaaS platform that allows users to create and manage fully functional online stores without requiring any coding knowledge. Users can register, create a store, customize its design, and manage products, orders, and payments.
